semantic_fragments.content: The PEMS DEVELOPMENT LIFE-CYCLE must include: a set of defined milestones; activities to be completed at each milestone with VERIFICATION methods; each activity including its inputs and outputs defined; each milestone identifies RISK MANAGEMENT activities that must be completed before that milestone; tailored plans detailing activities, milestones, and schedules; and documentation requirements.

The problem resolution system for PEMS DEVELOPMENT LIFE-CYCLE must meet the following criteria: (1) documented as part of PEMS DEVELOPMENT LIFE-CYCLE; (2) allows reporting of potential or existing problems affecting BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE; (3) includes an assessment of each problem for associated RISKS; (4) identifies criteria that must be met for the issue to be closed; (5) identifies the action to be taken to resolve each problem.

MANUFACTURER must consider HAZARDS associated with software and hardware aspects of PEMS including those associated with: incorporating PEMS into an IT-NETWORK; components of third-party origin; legacy subsystems when compiling list of known or foreseeable HAZARDS. This is verified against Risk Assessment Report Section 3 Questions from IEC 60601-1:2005+AMD1:2012+AMD2:2020 Edition 3.2-14.1 R50-R54.
